content_of_post_to_answer: How can I use the block method to manage my tasks, and why does it help with focus?
answer: The hidden benefit of time blocking is not just scheduling tasks; it is reducing the number of decisions your brain has to make throughout the day. Many people lose focus not because a task is difficult, but because they repeatedly negotiate with themselves about what to do next. A good block creates a boundary where attention can settle. The goal is not to control every minute, but to protect the moments when meaningful work deserves your full mind.
